# UIStroke

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("UIStroke")`

Draws an outline on the text or the border of its parent. On a text object it outlines the text, unless `ApplyStrokeMode` is `Border`. On any other object it outlines the border. A `UIGradient` under the stroke colors it.

An object can have several border strokes, ordered by `ZIndex`, and a text object can have one text stroke. A stroke does not change the layout, so a stroke drawn outside an object can overlap its neighbors.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ApplyStrokeMode` | `Enum.ApplyStrokeMode` | `Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Contextual` | read/write | What the stroke outlines. `Contextual` outlines the text of a text object and the border of any other object. `Border` always outlines the border. |
| `BorderOffset` | `UDim` | `UDim.new(0, 0)` | read/write | A distance by which a border stroke is moved outward, or inward when negative. Its scale is a fraction of the parent's shorter side. Text strokes ignore it. |
| `BorderStrokePosition` | `Enum.BorderStrokePosition` | `Enum.BorderStrokePosition.Outer` | read/write | Where a border stroke lies relative to the border: entirely outside it, centered on it, or entirely inside it. |
| `Color` | `Color3` | `Color3.new(0, 0, 0)` | read/write | The color of the stroke. |
| `Enabled` | `boolean` | `true` | read/write | Whether the stroke is drawn. |
| `LineJoinMode` | `Enum.LineJoinMode` | `Enum.LineJoinMode.Round` | read/write | How the stroke turns a corner: rounded, beveled or mitered. If the parent has a `UICorner`, a border stroke is always rounded. |
| `StrokeSizingMode` | `Enum.StrokeSizingMode` | `Enum.StrokeSizingMode.FixedSize` | read/write | Whether `Thickness` is in pixels or a fraction of the parent. |
| `Thickness` | `number` | `1` | read/write | The thickness of the stroke, in pixels. With `StrokeSizingMode.ScaledSize`, it is a fraction of the parent's shorter side, or of the font size on text. Animating the thickness of a text stroke is expensive, because each size needs a new outline. |
| `Transparency` | `number` | `0` | read/write | How transparent the stroke is, from 0 (opaque) to 1 (invisible). It is separate from the parent's transparency: a stroke on text whose `TextTransparency` is 1 gives hollow lettering. |
| `ZIndex` | `number` | `1` | read/write | The drawing order among the strokes of one object: lower values are drawn behind higher ones, and equal values are drawn in child order. |
